case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

You set out copper and labour as the pressure behind your price. Our options give you a clear, structured proposal on the other terms, so that your pricing committee has a complete case to decide on.

On quality:
Your quality was 273 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70510@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 358.48; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 358.71; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option C: unit price EUR 359.68; payment 60 days net; no index clause.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you a longer payment term than your offer and a clear price, and the quality record above supports that price level.

For your pricing committee, this paragraph can be forwarded as it stands: Hollerau Pumpenwerke proposes Option A, a fixed unit price with a longer payment term and no index clause. It gives Antriebstechnik Nordmark a clean, simple price basis for the 7.5 kW motor, and Hollerau can confirm the order as soon as Option A is confirmed unchanged.

Please take Option A to the committee. If it needs anything further to approve it, tell us and we will provide it. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your proposal and can accommodate the 45-day payment term requested in your Option A. Please note that extended payment terms increase our financing costs, which must be reflected in the unit price. Regarding the cited quality record, our performance remains fully within the agreed specifications and does not warrant a price reduction.

Our Angebot comprises a price of €371.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Quality Management: We meet the agreed quality targets.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your updated options and acknowledge the movement in your proposed pricing. We are pleased to maintain the 45-day payment term as outlined in your Option B.

Consequently, we can revise our price to €370.95 per unit, representing a further concession on our part to reach an agreement.

Our offer stands at a price of €374.05 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €370.95 per unit.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
